title: Why CEO Brian Armstrong made Coinbase a "Mission Focused Company"
description:
Tune into an unusually candid conversation with Brian Armstrong of Coinbase, a startup YC funded in 2012 and is now a publicly traded company. 

Listen to full episodes of The Social Radars on Spotify and Apple Podcasts: https://pod.link/1677066062

About the Show: Jessica Livingston and Carolynn Levy are The Social Radars. Carolynn and Jessica have been working together to help thousands of startups at Y Combinator for almost 20 years. Come be a fly on the wall as they talk to some of the most successful founders in Silicon Valley about how they did it.
fulltitle: Why CEO Brian Armstrong made Coinbase a "Mission Focused Company"
